purpose: Automation-friendly metadata for choosing player-castable FFXI sleep spells/actions to control a charmed party member.

included: Conditional Summoner Blood Pact sleep actions in a separate array
excluded: Non-sleep control effects such as Bind, Break, Stun, Terror, and Gravity
Weapon skills and item/proc sleeps from the main spell list
Trust/automaton behavior that is not directly player-castable/reliably selectable
scope.assumption: A charmed player is treated as a foe/enemy target for combat/spell purposes; FFXI strategy pages explicitly discuss sleeping charmed party members.

sleep_break_conditions: Direct HP-restorative actions such as Cure can wake Sleep.
DoT effects can wake Sleep on ticks, so poisoned or otherwise DoT'd charmed players may not stay asleep.
charm_specific_notes: Charmed players cannot operate normally and are treated as foes; sleeping them is a standard containment tactic.
Prefer not to damage the charmed player unless the alternative is worse.
Targeting/facing/position checks matter for BLU gaze and caster-centered AoE sleeps.
Resist Sleep traits/gear can make some players harder to sleep; light-based sleeps such as Repose/Lullaby/Sheep Song/Yawn may be preferable in some cases.

support_job_model.master_level_support_job_rule: Support job cap increases by 1 every 5 Master Levels, up to 59 at Master Level 50.

fields.minimum_master_level_for_subjob: Minimum Master Level on the main job needed for support job to reach that spell level, or null if impossible under ML50 cap.
fields.usable_as_subjob_with_ml50_cap: True if spell/action is at support job level 59 or lower.

strength_rating_1_to_5.5: Best practical control: long duration, strong overwrite/priority, safe/no damage, or excellent main-job option.
strength_rating_1_to_5.4: Strong but with meaningful caveat: AoE/caster-centered, element/resist concern, main-job-only, or recast/facing issue.
strength_rating_1_to_5.3: Usable baseline control: shorter duration or lower practical strength but safe enough to use.
strength_rating_1_to_5.2: Emergency/conditional only: damage, variable additional effect, DoT, pet timing, or major caveat.
strength_rating_1_to_5.1: Not recommended; retained only for completeness if present.

rating_model.selection_score_0_to_100: Opinionated automation score balancing duration, target safety, accessibility, element, AoE risk, cast/recast, and special requirements.

why_exclude_by_default.pinecone_bomb: Damages the charmed player and sleep is only an additional effect.
why_exclude_by_default.nightmare: Damages and adds DoT; high risk on a player target.

rules: Prefer single-target sleeps when exactly one player is charmed and enemy/add collateral is dangerous.
Prefer light-based sleep if dark-based sleep is likely to resist.
Prefer 90-second sleep over 60/30-second sleep when the spell can land reliably.
Avoid any sleep that damages the charmed player unless explicitly configured as emergency-only.
Do not cast a cure on a sleeping charmed player unless waking them is intended.
Avoid DoT on the charmed player before sleeping; DoT damage can wake Sleep.

sleep_spells.name: Sleep
special_requirements: SCH requires Addendum: Black.

selector.ranking_reason: Low-level, widely subjob-accessible single-target sleep. Weaker than 90-second sleeps but safer than AoE when only one party member is charmed.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Use when no tier-2 or light-based single-target sleep is available.
risks: Dark-based; less useful on targets with strong dark resistance or Resist Sleep traits.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Good fallback for any character with /BLM, /RDM, /DRK, /SCH, or /GEO access.

sleep_spells.name: Sleep II
special_requirements: SCH requires Addendum: Black.
overwrites_or_priority_notes: Overwrites tier-1 Sleep/Sleepga and tier-1 Lullaby-style sleeps according to common wiki notes.
Does not overwrite Repose per FFXIclopedia Repose notes.

selector.ranking_reason: 90-second single-target sleep with broad BLM/RDM access. Excellent for charmed players when dark-based sleep is acceptable.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Preferred dark-based single-target option for sleeping one charmed player.
risks: Dark-based; target may resist.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: At ML0, /BLM41 and /RDM46 can use it. /DRK56 requires main job ML35. /SCH65 and /GEO70 are not subjob-accessible under the ML50 support-job cap.

selector.ranking_reason: Useful when multiple party members are charmed or when target shadows/positioning make AoE attractive, but lower duration and AoE collateral risk make it worse than single-target 90-second options for one charm target.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Use when multiple nearby players are charmed or you need an accessible /BLM AoE sleep.
risks: Can sleep unintended enemies or hit the active boss/adds.
Dark-based; may resist.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Subjob-accessible at /BLM31 even without Master Levels.

selector.ranking_reason: 90-second AoE sleep. Extremely strong for multiple charm targets, but less safe than a single-target spell when only one party member is charmed.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Use when multiple party members are charmed or an AoE sleep is explicitly wanted.
risks: AoE may sleep unintended enemies or interact badly with boss positioning.
Dark-based; may resist.
Longer recast than Sleep/Sleep II.
automation_notes: Main BLM56 normally. /BLM56 becomes possible only on a main job with at least Master Level 35.

sleep_spells.name: Repose
overwrites_or_priority_notes: FFXIclopedia notes Repose overwrites Sleep/Horde Lullaby/Foe Lullaby/Yawn, but not Sleep II; Sleep II also does not overwrite Repose.

selector.ranking_reason: Best general-purpose charmed-player single-target sleep: 90 seconds, light-based, WHM48 is subjob-accessible, and it avoids AoE collateral.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: First-choice single-target spell when available, especially on WHM or /WHM characters.
risks: Accuracy is based on Divine Magic / magic accuracy, so non-WHM subjob users may need macc support.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Subjob-accessible at /WHM48 with no Master Levels needed.

sleep_spells.name: Foe Lullaby
special_requirements: Can be enhanced by Lullaby+ / All Songs+ gear and song-duration gear.
Job Points can add Lullaby duration for main BRD.

selector.ranking_reason: Shorter base duration than Repose/Sleep II, but fast, free, light-based, and subjob-accessible.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Good fast single-target sleep from BRD or /BRD, especially when dark sleep is unreliable.
risks: Shorter base duration unless enhanced by Bard gear.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Subjob-accessible at /BRD16. Useful emergency charm-control button on non-BRD if /BRD is present.

sleep_spells.name: Horde Lullaby

targeting.aoe_radius_yalms: small; radius affected by instrument/skill mechanics

special_requirements: Can be enhanced by Lullaby+ / All Songs+ gear and song-duration gear.
String instruments can affect Horde Lullaby AoE radius mechanics.

selector.ranking_reason: Fast AoE light sleep. Lower base duration than tier-II lullabies, but available as /BRD and useful for multiple charm targets.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Use when multiple party members are charmed or when a fast /BRD AoE light sleep is the best available option.
risks: AoE can hit enemies you did not intend to sleep.
Shorter base duration unless enhanced.
Will break on damage or cure effects.

sleep_spells.name: Foe Lullaby II
special_requirements: Main BRD only in practical terms; not subjob-accessible under current support-job cap.
Can be enhanced by Lullaby+ / All Songs+ gear, song-duration gear, Troubadour, and JP duration.

selector.ranking_reason: High-end single-target light sleep with fast cast/recast and strong Bard duration scaling. Great on real BRD, unavailable as a subjob.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Preferred BRD single-target option for one charmed player.
risks: Will break on damage or cure effects.
Main BRD only; not usable from /BRD.
automation_notes: If a main BRD has this, rank it near Repose/Sleep II for one target.

sleep_spells.name: Horde Lullaby II

targeting.aoe_radius_yalms: small; radius affected by instrument/skill mechanics

special_requirements: Main BRD only in practical terms; not subjob-accessible under current support-job cap.
Can be enhanced by Lullaby+ / All Songs+ gear, song-duration gear, Troubadour, and JP duration.

selector.ranking_reason: High-end AoE light sleep. Excellent for multiple charm targets, but less safe than single-target Lullaby II if only one player is charmed.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Preferred BRD AoE option when multiple players are charmed or clustered.
risks: AoE collateral.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
Main BRD only; not usable from /BRD.
automation_notes: Use single-target Foe Lullaby II instead when only one target needs control and collateral sleep is risky.

sleep_spells.name: Sheep Song
special_requirements: BLU spell must be learned and set.
Creates Auto Regen trait when paired with Healing Breeze.

selector.ranking_reason: Subjob-accessible AoE light sleep. Shorter and close-range, but useful from /BLU and good when dark sleep is poor.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Emergency /BLU light-based AoE sleep when the charmed player is close.
risks: Caster-centered AoE requires proximity to the charmed player.
AoE collateral.
Shorter duration than 90-second options.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Requires BLU spell to be set; check set spell list before selecting.

sleep_spells.name: Soporific
special_requirements: BLU spell must be learned and set.
Creates Clear Mind trait when paired with certain BLU spells.

selector.ranking_reason: 90-second /BLU-accessible sleep is strong, but dark element, close-range caster-centered AoE, and recast/collateral considerations keep it below Repose/Sleep II.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Strong /BLU option if the caster can safely stand near the charmed player.
risks: Caster-centered AoE requires proximity.
AoE collateral.
Dark-based; may resist.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Requires BLU spell set. If both Sheep Song and Soporific are set, prefer Soporific for duration unless dark resistance is likely.

sleep_spells.name: Yawn
special_requirements: BLU spell must be learned and set.
Gaze-based: target must be facing caster for the spell to take effect.

selector.ranking_reason: Long-duration light-based AoE sleep, but main-BLU-only and gaze/facing requirements make automation riskier.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Good main-BLU light sleep if the charmed player is facing the BLU and close enough.
risks: Gaze/facing requirement can fail in messy charm situations.
Caster-centered AoE/proximity risk.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Do not auto-select if target facing cannot be verified; prefer Dream Flower, Repose, or Sleep II if available.

sleep_spells.name: Dream Flower
special_requirements: BLU spell must be learned and set.
overwrites_or_priority_notes: Does not overwrite Sleep II, Sleepga II, or itself according to FFXIclopedia notes.

selector.ranking_reason: Excellent main-BLU 90-second AoE sleep with better range/recast than older BLU sleeps. Dark element and AoE collateral still matter.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Best main-BLU AoE sleep when multiple charm targets or close-range BLU control is needed.
risks: Dark-based; may resist.
AoE collateral.
Will break on damage or cure effects.
automation_notes: Main BLU only; not subjob-accessible. Prefer single-target options if only one charmed player and collateral is risky.

sleep_spells.name: Pinecone Bomb
special_requirements: BLU spell must be learned and set.
Deals physical damage before attempting Sleep additional effect.

selector.ranking_reason: Single-target and subjob-accessible, but it damages the charmed player and the sleep is an additional effect with variable duration.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Last-resort /BLU single-target sleep when other real sleep spells are unavailable.
risks: Can injure or kill the charmed player.
Additional-effect sleep may fail.
Physical accuracy and target defenses matter.
Will wake on later damage/cure effects.
automation_notes: Exclude from normal selector unless explicitly allowing damage-to-charmed-player emergency actions.

conditional_player_available_sleep_actio.name: Sleepga
special_requirements: Requires Shiva summoned and Blood Pact: Ward available.
Not a normal magic spell; included because it is a player-controlled sleep action.

selector.ranking_reason: 90-second AoE dark sleep available through SMN, including /SMN39, but pet command timing and Blood Pact recast make it less immediate than normal magic.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Useful if a SMN already has Shiva out or can execute Blood Pact quickly.
risks: AoE collateral.
Pet positioning/timing.
Dark-based resist.
Blood Pact recast lockout.
automation_notes: Keep out of normal spell selector unless pet-action support exists.

conditional_player_available_sleep_actio.name: Nightmare
special_requirements: Requires Diabolos summoned and Blood Pact: Ward available.
Not a normal magic spell; included because it is a player-controlled sleep action.
Adds damage/DoT behavior, so it is risky on player targets.

selector.ranking_reason: Can sleep, but damage/DoT makes it dangerous on a charmed player. Treat as emergency or excluded by default.

charmed_player_usage.best_use: Only when stopping the charmed player matters more than avoiding damage and no safer sleep exists.
risks: Can damage/kill the charmed player.
DoT/damage behavior is not desirable for sleep control.
AoE collateral.
Blood Pact timing/recast.
automation_notes: Default selector should exclude this unless allow_high_risk_sleep_actions=true.

excluded_or_related_control_options.name: Shockwave
excluded_or_related_control_options.reason_excluded: Player-available AoE sleep effect, but not a spell and it deals weapon-skill damage. Useful as a separate emergency-control table, not in the spell list.

excluded_or_related_control_options.name: Sleep Bolt / sleep-ammo style effects
excluded_or_related_control_options.reason_excluded: Not castable magic. Also depends on ranged attack accuracy/proc mechanics and may damage the charmed player.

excluded_or_related_control_options.name: Break / Breakga
excluded_or_related_control_options.reason_excluded: Crowd-control spell but inflicts Petrification, not Sleep.

excluded_or_related_control_options.name: Bind / Gravity / Stun / Terror effects
excluded_or_related_control_options.reason_excluded: Can help contain charm in some fights, but they are not sleep spells.

excluded_or_related_control_options.name: Maiden's Virelai
excluded_or_related_control_options.reason_excluded: Charm effect, not Sleep. Do not use as sleep control.
